_comment: Drop the `blender` entry into your MCP client's server configuration.
Claude Desktop keeps this in claude_desktop_config.json; other clients
use the same shape. Any client that speaks MCP over stdio will do -- no
endorsement by any client vendor is implied.
Replace the command with the absolute path to the binary you downloaded
from the releases page, or to target/release/blender-mcp if you built it
yourself. MCP clients do not search PATH. On Windows use forward slashes
BLENDER_MCP_EAGER_TOOLS=1 registers all 247 tools at startup. Leave it out
to start with the 10-tool core category and enable the rest on demand with
tools.categories.enable -- far cheaper in context, but only if your client
refreshes its tool list on notifications/tools/list_changed.
BLENDER_MCP_SKETCHFAB_TOKEN is optional and only needed for Sketchfab
downloads. Poly Haven needs no credentials. Never put a token anywhere
